data.name: 500 CrossBar Challenge
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

500 CrossBar Challenge is a football simulation game focused on pure precision. Your goal? Hit the crossbar. Again and again. 500 times.

🎯 UNIQUE GAMEPLAY

Forget classic matches. Here, only precision matters. Every shot is a challenge of physics and timing:

- Charge your power

- Choose your shot type

- Adjust parameters in real-time

- Aim for perfection

⚽ 5 SHOT TYPES

- NORMAL SHOT - The foundation, simple but effective

- CURVE RIGHT/LEFT - Controlled curves with adjustable intensity

- LOB - Parabolic trajectories with variable height

- RISING SHOT - Upward force to defy gravity

Each shot type has its own adjustable parameters to create unique trajectories.

🎮 GAME MODES

SOLO MODE: PROGRESSION

- 5 increasing difficulty levels

- Procedurally generated positions

- Variable distances and angles

- Perfect your technique at each level

LOCAL MULTIPLAYER MODE: ELIMINATION

- 2 to 10 players

- Tactical turn-based gameplay

- Only one can remain

- Level-based elimination system

- Who will be the champion?

📊 REALISTIC PHYSICS SYSTEM

- Authentic ballistic physics

- Dynamic curve effects

- Wind impact (coming soon)

- Realistic crossbar bounces

🌍 MULTILINGUAL SUPPORT

- Interface in English, French, and Spanish

- On-the-fly language switching

- More languages coming soon

🎨 FEATURES

✓ Intuitive controls: Space to charge, number keys for types

✓ Visual and audio feedback

✓ Procedural level generation

✓ Elimination ranking system

✓ Precise and satisfying physics

✓ Progressive challenges

🏆 ULTIMATE CHALLENGE

The title isn't just a name. It's a goal. 500 successful shots on the crossbar. Few have accomplished it. Are you ready to join the elite?

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Simplicity is key. 500 CrossBar Challenge runs on virtually any PC, allowing everyone to take on the challenge.
